answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the vault solution is checked at the sable gate and logged, the haven audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 18 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
